_comments: WHY THE HTML IS IN THE DATABASE. An invoice is the most-edited artefact in an order system and
the least interesting to a compiler: somebody wants the logo bigger, the remittance wording
changed, a VAT line added for one region. Every one of those is a deploy if the markup lives in
a TypeScript string, and none of them is a deploy if it lives here. The Action renders whatever
template it is pointed at, so a deployment can also override this one without forking the code.
ONE TEMPLATE COVERS INVOICE, QUOTE AND CREDIT MEMO. They are the same document with different
words on it; keeping three files in step by hand is how the credit memo ends up with last
The markup does no arithmetic — every figure arrives pre-formatted from InvoiceDisplay.ts — so
editing this template cannot make the page disagree with the ledger. That is the property that
makes it safe to hand to somebody who is not a developer.

fields.Name: Orders: Standard Invoice
fields.Description: The standard customer-facing document for an order: invoice, quote or credit memo depending on the order's status. Self-contained HTML with inline CSS — no external stylesheet, webfont or image host — so it renders identically as a PDF, in an email body, and opened straight from disk.
fields.UserPrompt: Render one InvoiceDocument (see InvoiceBehavior.ts) as a printable page. The `doc` variable is a DisplayInvoice; `options.ShowDiagnostics` reveals the internal notes block, which must never be sent to a customer.

fields.Name: Orders: Renewal Payment Link
fields.Description: The e-mail sent to a subscription's bill-to person after the renewal card's first failed charge, a decline or a bank's request to authenticate (#289). It carries the signed link that pays the renewal with a new card. Edit the wording here; the link, amounts and dates come from the code.
fields.UserPrompt: Render the update-card e-mail. Variables: FirstName, OrderNumber, SubscriptionNumber, Description (what renews), Amount (formatted), PaymentUrl, ExpiresOn and NextAttemptDay (YYYY-MM-DD, NextAttemptDay empty when none is left), AuthenticationRequired (true when the bank asked the buyer to confirm).

fields.Name: Orders: Renewal Payment Link Subject
fields.Description: The subject line of the update-card e-mail (#289). Same variables as Orders: Renewal Payment Link. Whitespace is collapsed to one line.
fields.UserPrompt: Render one subject line for the update-card e-mail, from the same variables as Orders: Renewal Payment Link.
